On-call engineers spent the first phase of the investigation inspecting database connection pools and batch job logs across the upstream environment. That line of enquiry ended late in the morning once platform diagnostics confirmed that ERP logs show no interruption during the valuation window. Eliminating the upstream database hypothesis forced the response team to trace record rejections inside the cloud ingestion layer. Log inspection inside the hierarchy synchronisation job quickly revealed unmapped legacy agency codes in the reference register. Engineers then prepared a verified mapping patch and re-ran the pipeline until Asset valuation completed.
